verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line in Svelte's own docs telling Svelte 4 users which syntax carries over unchanged. That implies first-party guidance for the Svelte 4→5 transition, but nothing in the pack shows a dedicated migration guide. Community comments mention rough breaking changes but say nothing about migration documentation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a dedicated migration guide page, step-by-step coverage of the breaking changes, migration tooling, and independent corroboration that the guide works in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow a dedicated migration guide when moving between two incompatible major versions of the framework

citations.quote: Other syntax not explicitly listed like `{#if ...}` blocks stay the same, so you can reuse your Svelte 4 knowledge for these.
